PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday JULY 13, 2017
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Commissioner Avery, French, and Ward
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of June 8, 2017
7
8. Public Hearings
8A. Tentative Tract Map (TTM) 66687 Time Extension (TE) No. 2, Site Plan Review (SPR) 3-06-1 Time Extension (TE) No. 2, General Plan Amendment 17-001, and Zone Change 17-016
Beazer Homes Holdings Corporation, Applicant
Requests for the following items: a) a request for a three-year time extension to develop a 48 condominium unit project; b) a request to amend the General Plan Land Use Designation on approximately 18,000 square feet from OC (Office Commercial) to MR (Medium Residential); and c) a request to change the Zone Designation on approximately 18,000 square feet from C-2 (Office Commercial) to R-2 (Medium Residential) located east of Fairway Drive, approximately 565 feet north of Rancho Vista Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-019 approving Tentative Tract Map (TTM) 66687 Time Extension (TE) No. 2 and Site Plan Review (SPR) 3-06-1 Time Extension (TE) No. 2 and find that the project will not result in any changes to the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration adopted for this project. It is also recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-024 recommending that the City Council approve General Plan Amendment (GPA) 17-001 and Zone Change (ZC) 17-016 and find that the project will not result in any changes to the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration adopted for this project. Victor Mendez, Assistant Planner
8A
8B. Tentative Tract Map (TTM) 61940 Time Extension 1
A request for a three-year time extension to subdivide approximately five acres into 16 single-family residential lots and one detention basin lot located at the northeast corner of Avenue S-8 and 42nd Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission continue this item to the Planning Commission meeting of August 10, 2017, due to the project site sign posting requirements not being met. Victor Mendez, Assistant Planner
8B
8C. Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 17-010
Romy Colin, Applicant
A request to establish a religious assembly use (Iglesia Misionera Jesucristo Viene Pronto) within an existing tenant space located at 38750 Trade Center Drive, Suite C.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-026 approving a request to establish a religious assembly use (Iglesia Misionera Jesucristo Viene Pronto) within an existing 990 square foot tenant space and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
8C
8D. Specific Plan Amendment (SPA) 17-001
Mr Rick Sebo, Applicant
A request to amend the Palmdale Transit Village Specific Plan to allow the reauthorization of expired legal non-conforming uses throughout the Palmdale Transit Village Specific Plan.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-027 recommending that the City Council approve Specific Plan Amendment (SPA) 17-001 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
8D
8D Exhibit
8E. Zoning Ordinance Amendment (ZOA) 17-002
City of Palmdale, Applicant
A request to amend the Palmdale Municipal Code (PMC) regarding the keeping of dogs and cats.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-028 recommending that the City Council approve Zoning Ordinance Amendment (ZOA) 17-002, and find that the proposed project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
8E
8F. Zoning Ordinance Amendment (ZOA) 17-003
City of Palmdale, Applicant
A request to amend Palmdale Municipal Code regarding Accessory Dwelling Unit Standard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-031 recommending that the City Council approve Zoning Ordinance Amendment (ZOA) 17-003 and find that the project is exempt from environmental review. Perry Banner, Contract Planner
8F
9. Staff Communications Development Update
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
10. Planning Commission Communications
11. Adjournment to the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, August 10, 2017, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber
